key_findings: Acupuncture and moxibustion raised pain thresholds in CCI rats and lowered spinal IL-1beta, IL-6, IL-18, TNF-alpha, NOX1/2/4 and NLRP3.
Authors propose the NOX-ROS-NLRP3 pathway as mechanism.
